<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_birl3_clm.CLMSwapScenarioHelper</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CLMSwapScenarioHelper</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CLMSwapScenarioHelper = Class.create();
CLMSwapScenarioHelper.prototype = {

  initialize: function() {},

  // ── Main method: detect scenario ──────────────────────
  detectScenario: function(donorSiteId, doneeSiteId) {
    var donorInfo = this._getSiteInfo(donorSiteId);
    var doneeInfo = this._getSiteInfo(doneeSiteId);

    gs.info('CLMSwap | Donor depot:' + donorInfo.depot + 
            ' region:' + donorInfo.region + 
            ' zone:' + donorInfo.zone + 
            ' segment:' + donorInfo.segment);
    gs.info('CLMSwap | Donee depot:' + doneeInfo.depot + 
            ' region:' + doneeInfo.region + 
            ' zone:' + doneeInfo.zone + 
            ' segment:' + doneeInfo.segment);

    // Scenario A: Same depot (same TSH)
    if (donorInfo.depot && donorInfo.depot === doneeInfo.depot) {
      return 'A';
    }

    // Scenario B: Same region, different depot
    if (donorInfo.region && donorInfo.region === doneeInfo.region) {
      return 'B';
    }

    // Scenario C: Same zone, different region
    if (donorInfo.zone && donorInfo.zone === doneeInfo.zone) {
      return 'C';
    }

    // Scenario D: Same segment, different zone
    if (donorInfo.segment && donorInfo.segment === doneeInfo.segment) {
      return 'D';
    }

    // Scenario E: Different segment
    return 'E';
  },

  // ── Get site hierarchy info from customer table ────────
  _getSiteInfo: function(siteId) {
    var info = {
      depot:   '',
      region:  '',
      zone:    '',
      segment: ''
    };

    var cm = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_customer');
    cm.get(siteId);
    if (!cm.isValidRecord()) return info;

    // Based on the field mapping we discovered:
    // Zone = customer_group
    // Region = cg4
    // Depot = sales_office
    // Segment = company_code
    info.depot   = cm.getValue('sales_office')   || '';
    info.region  = cm.getValue('cg4')            || '';
    info.zone    = cm.getValue('customer_group') || '';
    info.segment = cm.getValue('company_code')   || '';

    return info;
  },

  // ── Get approver from approval matrix ─────────────────
  getApprover: function(depot, region, zone, segment, roleName) {
    var am = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_approval_matrix');

    if (roleName === 'TSH') {
      am.addQuery('depot', depot);
    } else if (roleName === 'RHM') {
      am.addQuery('region', region);
    } else if (roleName === 'ZHM') {
      am.addQuery('zone', zone);
    } else if (roleName === 'NSH' || roleName === 'Segment Head') {
      am.addQuery('segment', segment);
    }

    am.addQuery('role_name', roleName);
    am.addQuery('customer_type', 'non_trade');
    am.setLimit(1);
    am.query();

    if (am.next()) {
      return am.getValue('approver_user');
    }
    return null;
  },

  // ── Build full approval chain for a swap record ───────
  buildApprovalChain: function(donorSiteId, doneeSiteId) {
    var donorInfo  = this._getSiteInfo(donorSiteId);
    var scenario   = this.detectScenario(donorSiteId, doneeSiteId);
    var chain      = {
      scenario:         scenario,
      donor_tsh:        null,
      donor_rhm:        null,
      donor_zhm:        null,
      shared_authority: null
    };

    // Always get donor TSH (needed for B, C, D, E)
    chain.donor_tsh = this.getApprover(
      donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region, 
      donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'TSH'
    );

    if (scenario === 'B') {
      chain.shared_authority = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'RHM'
      );
    }

    if (scenario === 'C') {
      chain.donor_rhm = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'RHM'
      );
      chain.shared_authority = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'ZHM'
      );
    }

    if (scenario === 'D') {
      chain.donor_rhm = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'RHM'
      );
      chain.donor_zhm = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'ZHM'
      );
      chain.shared_authority = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'NSH'
      );
    }

    if (scenario === 'E') {
      chain.donor_rhm = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'RHM'
      );
      chain.donor_zhm = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'ZHM'
      );
      chain.shared_authority = this.getApprover(
        donorInfo.depot, donorInfo.region,
        donorInfo.zone,  donorInfo.segment, 'Segment Head'
      );
    }

    gs.info('CLMSwap | Scenario: ' + scenario + 
            ' | Chain: ' + JSON.stringify(chain));

    return chain;
  },

  type: 'CLMSwapScenarioHelper'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>shobharani.k@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-27 08:37:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>9c2d25ea2b8d47104572f3745e91bfb1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CLMSwapScenarioHelper</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9c2d25ea2b8d47104572f3745e91bfb1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>shobharani.k@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-27 08:37:40</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
